privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At ForexsAi, we value your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how your personal data is collected, used, protected, and what your rights are. By using our platform, you agree to this policy.

account.title: 1.1 Account Information
account.text: When you register on our platform, we collect: email address, encrypted password (hash), name (optional), profile picture (optional).

usage.title: 1.2 Usage Data
usage.text: Data automatically collected when using our services: IP address, browser type and version, device information, page view statistics, session duration, preferred language settings.

analytics.title: 1.3 Analytics Data
analytics.text: To improve platform performance: feature usage, error reports, performance metrics. This data is collected anonymously and is not linked to your personal identity.

service.title: 2.1 Service Delivery
service.text: To create and manage your account, provide AI-powered market analysis, deliver personalized experience, provide technical support.

communication.title: 2.2 Communication
communication.text: Important updates and announcements, security notifications, account activity alerts, marketing communications (with your consent).

development.title: 2.3 Development
development.text: To improve service quality, develop new features, optimize user experience, detect and fix errors.

encryption.title: 3.1 Encryption
encryption.text: All data transfers are protected with 256-bit SSL/TLS encryption. Passwords are hashed using bcrypt algorithm. Sensitive data is protected with AES-256 encryption standard.

infrastructure.title: 3.2 Infrastructure Security
infrastructure.text: Your data is hosted on secure cloud infrastructure (Railway, Supabase). Regular security audits and penetration tests are conducted. 24/7 monitoring and threat detection is active.

access.title: 3.3 Access Control
access.text: Access to your data is limited to authorized personnel who need it for their job duties. All access is logged and audited.

providers.title: 4.1 Service Providers
providers.text: Data is shared with the following trusted service providers: Supabase (database and authentication), Railway (application hosting), Resend (email services). These providers comply with GDPR and industry standards.

legal.title: 4.2 Legal Requirements
legal.text: In case of legal obligation (court order, official request, etc.), your data may be shared with authorities. We will inform you to the extent permitted by law.

noSale.title: 4.3 Sale or Transfer
noSale.text: Your personal data is never sold to third parties or shared for marketing purposes under any circumstances.

access.title: 5.1 Right of Access
access.text: You can request a copy of all data we store about you.

correction.title: 5.2 Right to Correction
correction.text: You can request correction of incorrect or incomplete data.

deletion.title: 5.3 Right to Deletion
deletion.text: You can permanently delete your account and all associated data. Deletion is completed within 30 days.

portability.title: 5.4 Data Portability
portability.text: You can request your data in a commonly used, machine-readable format (JSON).

objection.title: 5.5 Right to Object
objection.text: You can object to data processing or opt out of marketing communications.
